q1_issues.issue: The stated modifier "dim" in "the dim lanterns of the Hollows" is dropped entirely, so the pattern matches any lantern group of the Hollows rather than the restricted set the question names.

notes: ReasonFor on the focus event, During for "during", Goal for "flee to", the participial modifier "surviving" as a property, and the Name-bound "Hollows" all follow the instruction set. The two decomposition conjuncts (Inheritance nightmoth moth) and (Inheritance sky_cat_hunt hunt) are needless constraints inside a query — they can only drop answers, never bind one.
